.. change::
    :tags: bug, autogenerate
    :tickets: 326

    Autogenerate now uses :func:`sqlalchemy.schema.sort_tables_and_constraints`
    when arranging ``CREATE TABLE`` / ``DROP TABLE`` operations.  Foreign key
    constraints that are marked ``use_alter=True``, or that participate in a
    dependency cycle between new or dropped tables, are rendered as separate
    :meth:`.Operations.create_foreign_key` /
    :meth:`.Operations.drop_constraint` directives instead of being inlined
    into the table DDL, which previously produced CREATE TABLE statements
    that referenced tables not yet created.
